title: Ytterbium
description: adds ytterbium to your world. make gamma rays and use precise clocks.
body:
# features of Ytterbium:
- **ytterbium staff** (craft like a big stick of ytterbium). it applies the radiation effect and has a range of 6. ytterbium is a source of gamma rays
- **ytterbium ore** naturally generates, drops **ytterbium**
- **radiation effect**, sets baby's on fire, adults glow and damages any mob or player that has it. you can get it by being hit with gamma rays (from the ytterbium staff)
- **ytterbium powder** can be composted, used as furnace fuel and ignites when dropped. crafted with ytterbium
- an **analog clock** block that cycle redstone output from 0 to 15 increasing every tick
- a **binary clock** that toggles on/0ff every tick
- **display**, displaying the input signal strength in hex (needs better texture)
